Welcome to MoBILE’s documentation!

The Mobility-Based Integrated Landscape Epidemiology (MoBILE) model is an open source FORTRAN program developed at the Earth System Physics section of ICTP, Trieste (Italy).

Authors in alphabetic order

  • Adrian M. Tompkins (ICTP)

  • Cyril Caminade (ICTP)

  • Miguel Garrido Zornoza (ICTP)

For issues not included in this documentation, please reach out at mobile@ictp.it.

Note

This project is under active development. Current features in development are:

  • Coupling with the VECtor-borne disease community model of ICTP, TRIeste (VECTRI).

\(\rightarrow\) Check out the Usage section for further information, including how to install and run the program as well as post-process its output.

\(\rightarrow\) For an in-depth model description try the Model description section.

\(\rightarrow\) For insights into advance tools and example case studies where MoBILE has been used try the Advanced usage section.
